data.name: Phaidra
data.long_meaning: In Greek mythology, Phaidra is the name of a woman who falls in love with her husband's young student. Her name is derived from the Greek word phos, meaning 'light' or 'bright'. This name evokes images of a shining, radiant woman, full of passion and desire.
